page.layout: One page of text, full width. Running head top right "Pag. I" above the title. Title block centred, then a rule, then the heading BREVIARIUM, then a list of numbered lines in italic. Catchword-like signature "A" and the start "IX. Epi-" at the foot, bottom right.

main_text.head: ECCLESIÆ ROMANÆ PERIODUS PRIMA.
Historia Ecclesiæ Romanæ in Doctrina & Regimine purioris,
main_text.p: Inde ab initio Ecclesiæ illius ad tempus Constantini M. seu A. C. cccxiv. usque.
main_text.head: BREVIARIUM.
main_text.l: I. Origo Ecclesiæ Romanæ varie disceptata est.
II. Circa eam certa ac explorata ab incertis, dubüs, suspectis & falsis distinguuntur.
III. Historia ejus septem periodis divisa.
IV. Ejus ab Apostolis fundatæ celebritas. Elogia eidem à S. Patribus tributa.
V. Primorum Ecclesiæ Romanæ Antistitum gloria fuit humilitas.
VI. Apostolorum tempore nondum impune grassari hæreticis licuit.
VII. Ecclesia Romana prima præ cæteris ab hæresi immunis fuit.
VIII. Cypriani & Hieronymi elogia, quibus ejus sinceritatem commendant, ad ejus perpetuitatem perperam trahuntur.

page.notes: Title page style layout with large capitals; the "Pag. I" at top right is a printed page marker. The final line "IX. Epi-" is a catchword-like line at the foot; the signature "A" stands at bottom left of it. Some roman numerals in the list (e.g. "III.", "VI.") are uncertain in the scan and may be misread. Long s rendered as s throughout.
